headline: “Just an Assault”: Civil Servants Union Tears Into New Minimum Wages as Cost of Living Crushes Workers | Nyasa Times
summary: Malawi's Civil Servants Trade Union criticised newly announced minimum wage adjustments as the cost of living rises. Labour leaders have voiced outrage over the changes.
why: Minimum wage changes affect labour costs, inflation pressure and fiscal spending, which matter for investors in frontier economies.
